objective: Reduce true C1 fused-MoE latency by porting B12X small-M route/slice work decomposition without changing the P8 codec or arithmetic contract.

baseline.schedule: deterministic monolithic M16, one all-slices task per active expert tile

candidate.schedule: P8-native M1 route-by-K128 FC1 tasks and route-by-N256 FC2 tasks modeled on the existing B12X M1 decomposition
forbidden_shortcuts: enable the existing E2M1 M1 FC2 unchanged
change the codebook, scale law, weights, routes, activation format, or checkpoint
open selection, confirmation, final, or the 28 reserved confirmation logits

test_order: single-device identical-payload M1/M2/M3 numerical closure on full E288 geometry
five-run bitwise determinism with poisoned reusable scratch
captured-graph kernel A/B on identical payloads and routes
four-rank integrated synthetic C1 trace if the kernel A/B passes
new separately frozen whole-model product gate only after integrated closure

promotion_rules.numerical: all finite and bit-exact BF16 output versus the frozen deterministic baseline for every tested row
promotion_rules.determinism: five of five output hashes identical for baseline and candidate
promotion_rules.kernel_speed: candidate median fused-MoE device time must be lower on every measured GPU; report magnitude without a post-hoc threshold
promotion_rules.graph: candidate must remain capturable and replay from a fixed-address workspace
promotion_rules.serving: no throughput claim until a fresh preregistered multi-run product comparison completes

claim_boundary: Developmental runtime optimization only. It cannot alter the completed speed failure, authorize the stopped Shapley allocation game, or qualify codec KLD.
